quests.instruction: Touch the body part that closes gently every time you blink. It is also the one that shuts tight when you fall asleep at night!
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: They close every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Your eyelids blink automatically to keep your eyes clean and safe!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that squeezes and pulls to help every part of you move. It is also the one found under your skin, all over your body!
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: They help every part of your body move!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Your body has more than six hundred muscles working together!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the front of your leg, between your knee and your ankle. It is also the one that can feel very sore if you bump it on a table!
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: They are the front of your lower legs!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: The bone in your shin is one of the strongest bones in your body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets your food travel down to your tummy when you swallow. It is also the one found inside your neck, where your voice comes from!
quests.question: Throat
quests.hint: It is inside your neck!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: Your throat helps you swallow food, breathe, and even make your voice!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms two little openings at the bottom of your nose. It is also the one that flares open wide when you breathe in deeply!
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: They are the two little holes in your nose!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: You actually breathe more through one nostril at a time, and they take turns!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a little round dot in the middle of your tummy. It is also the one that shows where you were once connected to your mother before you were born!
quests.question: Belly Button
quests.hint: It is the little dot in the middle of your tummy!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Everybody has a belly button, and everybody's looks a little different!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that wears a hat when it is cold outside!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You shake it side to side to say no.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Wearing a helmet on your bike keeps this part extra safe.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found right under your shoulder, where your arm meets your body. It is also the one that gets gently squeezed when you hug someone tight!
quests.question: Armpits
quests.hint: They are right under your arms!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: Armpits can feel extra ticklish because the skin there is very sensitive!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms small bumps you can see when you make a tight fist. It is also the one that lets your fingers bend and curl!
quests.question: Knuckles
quests.hint: You see these bumps when you make a fist!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: Your knuckles are the joints that let your fingers curl into a fist!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we brush every morning to make it neat!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It sits right on top, above your forehead.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: No two people have the exact same hair, just like fingerprints.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we use to jump high like a bunny!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to kick a ball.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: You use your legs to run, jump, climb, and dance.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you turn to look left and right!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Here's a tip: A scarf wraps around this part in winter.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Giraffes have very long necks, but yours works the very same way.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that stretches out wide when you fly like an airplane. It is also the one you use to carry your favorite teddy bear!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: You have two, and you hug people with them!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Babies learn to reach out with their arms very early on.

quests.instruction: Find the body part where your arms connect to your body. It is also the one you lift up high when you play airplane!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Your backpack straps rest right on these!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Shoulders help you throw a ball far and fast.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you use to pick up a small button. It is also the one that wiggles when you play the piano!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: You have five on each hand!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: No two people in the whole world share the same fingerprints.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that turns pink when you feel shy or cold and touch it!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: Think about this: They puff up when you blow out birthday candles.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Babies often have extra round, chubby cheeks.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that has your eyes, nose, and mouth on it and touch it!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Think about this: Your eyes, nose, and mouth are all part of it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Smiling uses fewer muscles in your face than frowning.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that helps you hear someone call your name. It is also the one that never stops working, even while you are asleep!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: You have two, one on each side of your head!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: The smallest bones in your whole body are inside your ears.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you use to lick a melting ice cream cone. It is also the one that moves around your mouth to help you speak clearly!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: It helps you taste sweet, sour, and salty foods!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Everyone's tongue print is different, just like a fingerprint.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that bends right in the middle of your arm and touch it!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: Think about this: You bend these to bring food to your mouth.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: That funny, tingly feeling when you bump your elbow has a nickname: the funny bone.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you press together gently to blow a kiss and touch it!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: Think about this: They are the soft edges around your mouth.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Lips do not have the tiny glands that keep the rest of your skin moist.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we clap together to cheer for our friends. It is also the one we wash with soap and water before we eat!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: You clap these together to cheer!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: You use your hands to write, draw, and build almost every day.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found at the very back of your foot, below your ankle!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: Hint: They touch the ground first when you take a step.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: A cushiony pad inside each heel helps soften every step.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that feels if something is soft, rough, hot, or cold!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Hint: It helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Skin protects everything inside your body, like a snug, stretchy coat.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found under your skin, all over your body?
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: They are found under your skin.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Muscles get stronger every time you run, climb, or play.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that shuts tight when you fall asleep at night?
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: They shut tight when you sleep.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Eyelids close on their own when you sleep, without you even trying.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that can feel very sore if you bump it on a table?
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: They are between your knee and your ankle, in front.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: Shins can feel extra sore because the bone sits close to your skin.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that flares open wide when you breathe in deeply?
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: Air goes in and out through these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: Nostrils help warm and clean the air before it reaches your lungs.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you rub together to warm up on a cold day!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: Hint: A high five lands right on these.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Your palms help you get a good, safe grip on things.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found right below your chest!
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: Hint: You pat this after a big meal.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: It takes a few hours for your tummy to digest a meal.
